name: Pharmacy and Laboratory Management
scope_from_master_specification: Medicine catalogue/classification, prescriptions/dispensing, batches/expiry, stock, suppliers, pricing and billing; lab catalogue, sample registration/tracking, processing, result validation, reports, doctor access, equipment, inventory and quality control.
implemented: Medicine catalogue linked to inventory products
Batch receipt, expiry visibility, quarantine and stock ledger integration
Laboratory test catalogue and encounter-linked test orders
Result entry with independent second-person validation
remaining_before_production: Lab instrument integration and quality control
Clinical result delivery and critical-value escalation
Granular clinical roles, privacy controls, security testing and UAT
